scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); let html = fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html', 'utf8'); html = html.replace(/<script id=\"root-redirect\">[\s\S]*?<\/script>/, ''); fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.html', html); if (fs.existsSync('docs')) fs.rmSync('docs', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('dist', 'docs', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('dist/assets', 'assets', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'docs/404.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', '404.html'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/.nojekyll', ''); fs.writeFileSync('docs/.nojekyll', ''); fs.writeFileSync('.nojekyll', '');"
